title: COSMIC COLLAGE (SAMPLE LAB 01, candidate B)
description: Psychedelic loop: one CRATE-01 chord chop sinks a whole tone per bar (Dbmaj9 | Bmaj9 | Amaj9 | Gmaj9#11) under a constant GLASS CHOIR hook, then snaps back up a tritone at the loop. Two identical cycles plus a bar of tail room; the deliverable is the second cycle.

tracks.description: GLASS CHOIR hook, 3+3+3+3+2+2, drifting across the stereo field.
CRATE-01 Dbmaj9 chop pair, a whole tone lower each bar, filtered and breathing against the kick.
The same chop an octave below the bed, swelling under bars 3-4: the record dragging to a halt.
ghost-vox grains: a rising stutter into the loop point and one low answer.
bass-db.wav: sinking roots that slide down into each bar, then an 18-semitone dive.
mechanical-kick at 0.93, displaced around the hook.
industrial-snare at 0.8: a late half-time backbeat with ghosts, in a bigger room.
pixel-hat at 0.86 changing subdivision by beat.
glass-hit at a quarter speed, gated to a wooden knock on a dotted-eighth cycle.
air-texture swells breathing into bar 3 and into the loop point.
